title: Free Music Starter Pack — 20 royalty-free tracks in 9 styles, commercial use
author: AndySv
selftext:
Free music pack — 20 tracks in 9 styles: action cinematic, sci-fi, orchestral, hard rock, electronic techno, retro chiptune, casual and acoustic.

34 WAV files in total, most tracks include a looping version, so they drop straight into a project without editing.

Preview: https://soundcloud.com/muzstation-game-music/free-music-starter-pack

Download: https://andrewsitkov.itch.io/free-music-starter-pack-for-games-video-streams

LICENSE

Free to use in your projects, commercial and personal. No attribution required, no signup, no email wall.

You may not resell or redistribute the tracks, or claim them as your own.

All music is composed and produced by hand in FL Studio, using licensed VST instruments and sample libraries — no AI generation at any stage: https://youtu.be/EXZ5tuJJkMU

Happy to answer questions about licensing, or take commissions if you need something written specifically for your project.
